title: RF23BB inner display — Engineer Mode entry
description: < + > 6 s → Engineer Mode → select Test (1), Self-diagnosis (3), or Load (7).

steps.title: Enter Engineer Mode
steps.body: Press < and > together ≥6 s until blink. Press > to enter Engineer Mode. Use < / > to select mode, O to confirm.
